rv.q: But what never falters is the show's unassailable good-natured charm, warmly reciprocated by Antoine and Scott as they keep the energy levels up wonderfully in Pia Furtado's bouncy production.

Dirty Great Love Story is not for the dainty — it contains bad language and sexual descriptions — but it is cheerfully forthright about modern dating shenanigans and is performed with good humour and imagination.
I wasn’t quite so wowed by what is really more an efficient and emotional piece of storytelling than a great play per se.
“Dirty Great Love Story” is best attended after a drink or three.
